description: Synergy Dashboard - Visual Kanban board for multi-platform project tracking. UPDATED Nov 9, 2025: All UI display issues fixed, enhanced UX with smooth transitions and click-to-copy. Call synergy_agent_instructions('quickstart') for detailed workflow guidance.

tools.name: synergy_smart_project_tracker
tools.description: SMART TOOL: Complete multi-platform project tracking in ONE call. Creates Synergy session with initial structure. Use this for ANY multi-step project involving 3+ tools/platforms. PRIMARY tool for complex work - use instead of calling multiple individual functions. CRITICAL: After creating EACH resource, you MUST call synergy_get_session() first, then synergy_update_session() to add document URLs. See synergy_agent_instructions('quickstart') for complete workflow.

guidance.when_to_use: Multi-platform projects involving 3+ tools, complex workflows, need visual tracking, cross-conversation context
guidance.before_calling: Have clear project scope, list of platforms involved, initial next steps defined
guidance.after_calling: CRITICAL: Save session_id. After creating EACH resource call synergy_get_session(), then synergy_update_session() with ALL documents
common_mistakes: Creating resources but forgetting to update session (dashboard shows 0 documents)
Losing session_id and can't update project later
Not fetching existing documents before updating (causes data loss)

description.description: What you're building and why (multi-platform context)

priority.description: Priority level (default: high for multi-platform work)

start_in_column.description: Start in 'backlog' (planning) or 'in_progress' (active work). Default: in_progress

initial_documents.description: Documents already created (if any). More can be added via updates. IMPORTANT: Use 'title' field (not 'name') for document names.

next_steps.description: Action items checklist. Send simple strings - backend auto-converts to rich objects with completion tracking. AI agents should ALWAYS use simple strings for ease of use.

auto_update_mode.description: Reserved for future use. Currently you MUST manually call synergy_update_session() after each resource creation. Default: true

sync_to_google.description: Also create Google Task backup (Google users only). Default: false

notify_user.description: Tell user about created project. Default: true

returns.description: Session with session_id, all fields, and tracking info

parameters.title: Customer Onboarding System
parameters.description: Multi-platform automation: Gmail + Forms + Sheets for customer signup workflow

tools.name: synergy_create_session
tools.description: Create a new session card in Synergy Dashboard. Use for multi-step projects that span conversations. Synergy provides visual Kanban tracking. ALWAYS create Synergy session for complex projects (3+ tools, multi-platform). Returns session_id for tracking. Prefer synergy_smart_project_tracker() for most use cases.

guidance.when_to_use: Need more control than smart_project_tracker, setting specific fields, advanced use cases
guidance.before_calling: Consider if synergy_smart_project_tracker() would be simpler
guidance.after_calling: Save session_id. Update session after creating each resource.
common_mistakes: Using this instead of simpler synergy_smart_project_tracker()
Not saving session_id for later updates

title.description: Session title (required) - Clear, descriptive name for the project

project_name.description: Project name for grouping related sessions

kanban_column.description: Which Kanban column to place the card (default: backlog)

due_date.description: Due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

assignees.description: List of assignee names or emails

documents.description: List of document links (Google Docs, Sheets, Forms, Drive, etc.). Use 'name' field not 'title'.

thread_ids.description: Link conversation thread IDs to this session (e.g., ['thread_abc123'])

assigned_agents.description: AI agents assigned to work on this session (e.g., ['Research Agent', 'Email Agent'])

sync_google_tasks.description: Whether to sync this session to Google Tasks (default: false). Feature incomplete - not recommended.

sync_google_calendar.description: Whether to sync this session to Google Calendar as an event (default: false). Feature incomplete - not recommended.

returns.description: Created session object with session_id and all fields

tools.name: synergy_list_sessions
tools.description: List all sessions from Synergy Dashboard with optional filtering. Use to check what projects are in progress, review backlog, find specific sessions, or resume work from previous conversations.

guidance.when_to_use: Starting new conversation, user asks to continue previous work, checking project status, finding session_id
guidance.before_calling: Consider which filter would be most useful (column, priority, status)
guidance.after_calling: Save session_id if planning to work on found project
common_mistakes: Not filtering when looking for specific session (returns too many)
Forgetting to get full details with synergy_get_session() after finding ID

returns.description: List of session objects matching the filters (summary view, use synergy_get_session for full details)

tools.name: synergy_get_session
tools.description: Get complete details for a specific session by ID. Returns all 22 fields including documents, links, next_steps, checklist. CRITICAL: Always call this BEFORE updating arrays to get existing items and prevent data loss. See synergy_agent_instructions('updating_arrays') for safe patterns.

guidance.when_to_use: Before updating arrays (documents, links, etc.), viewing project details, resuming work on existing project
guidance.before_calling: Have session_id from list or creation
guidance.after_calling: If updating arrays, extract existing items, add/modify, then update with ALL items
common_mistakes: Updating documents without calling this first (CAUSES DATA LOSS)
Not extracting array fields before modifying them

returns.description: Complete session object with all 22 fields: session_id, title, description, documents, links, next_steps, checklist, kanban_column, priority, status, tags, assignees, platforms_involved, thread_ids, assigned_agents, due_date, created_at, last_active, completed_at, recent_activity, google_task_id, google_calendar_id

tools.name: synergy_update_session
tools.description: Update session fields. WARNING: Arrays (documents, links, next_steps, checklist, tags, assignees, platforms_involved) REPLACE entirely - MUST include ALL items (existing + new) or data will be lost. Simple fields (title, description, priority, status, kanban_column) just update. CRITICAL: Always call synergy_get_session() FIRST to get existing arrays. See synergy_agent_instructions('updating_arrays') for safe patterns.

guidance.when_to_use: Adding documents after resource creation, changing priority/status, moving columns, updating any field
guidance.before_calling: For array fields: Call synergy_get_session() first, get existing items, modify locally, then update with ALL
guidance.after_calling: Verify update succeeded, tell user about changes
common_mistakes: Updating documents=[new_doc] without existing ones (DELETES ALL EXISTING - DATA LOSS)
Using 'title' instead of 'name' field for documents
Using 'item' instead of 'task' field for checklist
Passing string next_steps when need completion tracking (use objects)

kanban_column.description: Move to different Kanban column (prefer synergy_move_session for this)

documents.description: WARNING: REPLACES all documents. MUST include ALL documents (existing + new) or data lost. Get existing via synergy_get_session() first. IMPORTANT: Use 'title' field (not 'name'). Format: [{title: 'Doc Name', url: 'https://...', type: 'google_doc'}]. Examples: [{title: 'Customer Database', url: 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc', type: 'google_sheet'}, {title: 'Project Brief', url: 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/def', type: 'google_doc'}]

links.description: WARNING: REPLACES all links. MUST include ALL links (existing + new). Get existing via synergy_get_session() first. Format: [{title: 'Dashboard', url: 'https://...'}]

oneOf.description: Simple next step description (RECOMMENDED for AI agents - backend auto-converts)
Next step with metadata (advanced - only if you need to preserve completion states)

next_steps.description: WARNING: REPLACES all next steps. Use simple strings ['Step 1', 'Step 2'] (RECOMMENDED). Backend auto-converts to rich objects. MUST include ALL steps (existing + new). Get existing via synergy_get_session() first.

tags.description: WARNING: REPLACES all tags. MUST include ALL tags. Format: ['email', 'automation', 'urgent']

assignees.description: WARNING: REPLACES all assignees. MUST include ALL assignees. Format: ['John Doe', 'jane@example.com']

platforms_involved.description: WARNING: REPLACES platforms list. MUST include ALL platforms. Format: ['gmail', 'sheets', 'forms']

task.description: Checklist item text (CRITICAL: use 'task' field, not 'text' or 'item')

completed_at.description: ISO timestamp when completed (optional, auto-set by frontend)

checklist.description: WARNING: REPLACES checklist. MUST include ALL items. Format: [{task: 'Main task', completed: false, subtasks: [{task: 'Subtask', completed: false}]}]

thread_ids.description: WARNING: REPLACES thread IDs list. Link conversation threads. Format: ['thread_123', 'thread_456']

assigned_agents.description: WARNING: REPLACES assigned agents list. Format: ['Research Agent', 'Email Agent', 'Data Agent']

sync_google_tasks.description: Also sync changes to Google Tasks (if linked). Feature incomplete - not recommended.

sync_google_calendar.description: Also sync changes to Google Calendar (if linked). Feature incomplete - not recommended.

returns.description: Updated session object with confirmation

tools.name: synergy_move_session
tools.description: Move a session to a different Kanban column. Use to progress work through stages (backlog → in_progress → review → done). Simpler than synergy_update_session() for just moving columns.

guidance.when_to_use: Moving project through workflow stages, marking progress, organizing Kanban board
common_mistakes: Using synergy_update_session(kanban_column=...) instead of this simpler tool

returns.description: Updated session object

tools.name: synergy_delete_session
tools.description: Delete a session from Synergy Dashboard. Use sparingly - prefer moving to 'done' column or setting status='archived' instead. Deletion is permanent.

guidance.when_to_use: Removing test sessions, canceling projects that are truly obsolete
guidance.before_calling: Consider if moving to 'done' or archiving would be better
guidance.after_calling: Session and all associated data permanently removed
common_mistakes: Deleting when should archive (loses historical context)
Deleting active project by mistake (can't undo)

returns.description: Success confirmation

tools.name: synergy_sync_to_google
tools.description: Sync an existing session to Google Tasks and/or Google Calendar. WARNING: Feature incomplete - not recommended for production use. Use when you want to add external sync to a session created without it.

guidance.before_calling: Check if sync features are actually needed
guidance.after_calling: May not work as expected - feature incomplete
common_mistakes: Relying on Google sync instead of Synergy dashboard

returns.description: Session object with google_task_id and/or google_calendar_event_id (if successful)

guidance.before_calling: Have the document URL and know what type it is
guidance.after_calling: Document is added to session, existing documents preserved
common_mistakes: Using synergy_update_session instead (requires fetching all documents first)

session_id.description: Session ID to add document to (required)

returns.description: Updated session with new document appended to documents array

guidance.before_calling: Have the URL and a descriptive title
guidance.after_calling: Link is added to session, existing links preserved

session_id.description: Session ID to add link to (required)

returns.description: Updated session with new link appended to links array

tools.name: synergy_create_internal_doc
tools.description: Create an internal document within a Synergy session. This stores long-form content (meeting notes, drafts, summaries) directly in the Synergy database without requiring external Drive/OneDrive. Content is stored as MARKDOWN for AI-friendly processing. The document will appear in the session's Documents section with a preview. Users can click to open an editor modal where they can edit, preview markdown rendering, export to Word/Google Docs/PDF/Email, and copy the doc_id for AI processing.

session_id.description: Synergy session ID to attach document to (required). Format: sess_YYYYMMDD_HHMM_title

title.description: Document title (required). Keep concise (e.g., 'Meeting Summary', 'Q4 Strategy Draft', 'Technical Spec')

content.description: Document content in MARKDOWN format (required). Supports: **bold**, *italic*, # headers, - bullet lists, - [ ] checklists, etc. This will be rendered in the preview tab and can be exported to formatted documents.

format.description: Content format (default: markdown). Use 'markdown' for AI-generated content (recommended). 'html' is available but markdown is preferred for editability.

returns.description: Created document with doc_id (format: int_doc_<timestamp>), title, preview (first 100 chars), and success status. Save the doc_id - user can paste it in chat for AI to retrieve/process the document.

tools.name: synergy_update_internal_doc
tools.description: Update an existing internal document's content or title. This increments the version number for tracking changes. Use this when user requests modifications to an existing internal document, or when you need to add content to a document you previously created.

doc_id.description: Internal document ID (required). Format: int_doc_<timestamp>. User can copy this from the UI or you can retrieve it from synergy_get_session().

content.description: Updated document content in markdown (optional). If provided, replaces existing content. Supports full markdown syntax.

title.description: Updated document title (optional). If provided, changes the document title.

returns.description: Updated document with new version number and updated_at timestamp

tools.name: synergy_get_internal_doc
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of an internal document by its doc_id. Intelligently handles both richtext and spreadsheet documents. For richtext: strips HTML and returns clean text. For spreadsheets: parses JSON data and formats as readable table. Use this when user pastes a doc_id in chat and asks you to read, summarize, or process the document.

returns.description: Full document with doc_id, title, doc_type (richtext/spreadsheet), content (clean parsed text), content_html (original HTML for richtext), content_json (structured data for spreadsheet), version, timestamps, and metadata

tools.name: synergy_export_internal_doc
tools.description: Export an internal document to various formats: Word (.docx in OneDrive), Google Doc (in Drive), PDF (via Word conversion), or send via Email (Gmail). The markdown content is automatically converted to formatted output. User must have OAuth credentials configured for the target platform.

doc_id.description: Internal document ID to export (required). Format: int_doc_<timestamp>

export_format.description: Export format (required). 'word' = .docx in OneDrive, 'google_doc' = Google Docs, 'pdf' = Word then convert, 'email' = send via Gmail

email_to.description: Recipient email address (required only for 'email' format). Example: 'user@example.com'

email_subject.description: Email subject line (optional, only for 'email' format). Defaults to 'Document: <title>'

returns.description: Export result with success status, URL (for word/google_doc/pdf), file_id (for OneDrive), document_id (for Google Docs), or message (for email). The exported document will have formatted markdown rendering (bold, italic, headers, lists, etc.)
